# gaussian_blur { #neuroim.gaussian_blur }

```python
gaussian_blur(
    vol,
    mask=None,
    sigma=None,
    window=None,
    *,
    fwhm_mm=None,
    truncate=4.0,
    normalize=True,
)
```

Apply a Gaussian blur to a volumetric image.

The kernel width is physical: ``sigma`` (standard deviation) and
``fwhm_mm`` are both in millimetres and are converted to per-axis voxel
sigma via ``vol.space.spacing``, so smoothing is isotropic in millimetres
regardless of voxel anisotropy -- the neuroim2 contract.  (Releases before
0.3.0 interpreted ``sigma`` in voxels.)

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Default    |
|-----------|--------------------------------------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| vol       | [NeuroVol](`neuroim.neuro_vol.NeuroVol`)               | The image volume to be smoothed. A 4-D NeuroVec is smoothed spatially, volume by volume.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | _required_ |
| mask      | [LogicalNeuroVol](`neuroim.neuro_vol.LogicalNeuroVol`) | Image mask defining the region where blurring is applied.  When supplied, ``verify.assert_same_space(vol, mask)`` is invoked first so a foreign-affine mask raises before any smoothing occurs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | `None`     |
| sigma     | [float](`float`)                                       | Gaussian standard deviation in millimetres. Default (None) is 2 mm. Mutually exclusive with ``fwhm_mm``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | `None`     |
| window    | [int](`int`)                                           | Explicit kernel half-width in voxels. ``window=1`` is exactly a 3x3x3 kernel. The default ``None`` derives support from the Gaussian width and ``truncate``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `None`     |
| fwhm_mm   | float, optional (keyword only)                         | Full width at half maximum, in millimetres (FWHM = 2.355 * sigma). Mutually exclusive with ``sigma``.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `None`     |
| truncate  | float, optional (keyword only)                         | Standard deviations retained when ``window`` is ``None``. Default 4, matching :func:`scipy.ndimage.gaussian_filter`.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | `4.0`      |
| normalize | bool, optional (keyword only)                          | How the mask boundary is handled when ``mask`` is given. ``True`` (default, as in neuroim2) insulates the blur to the mask: each in-mask voxel is computed from in-mask neighbours only and the kernel is renormalized by the in-mask weight. ``False`` keeps the legacy behaviour: the whole volume is blurred and in-mask voxels are copied from it. Voxels outside the mask keep their input values either way. | `True`     |

## Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                               | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
|--------|----------------------------------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [DenseNeuroVol](`neuroim.neuro_vol.DenseNeuroVol`) | The smoothed image.  Carries a populated :class:`~neuroim.results.Receipt` in ``.provenance`` recording ``method_name="gaussian_blur"`` or an upstream-chained method name such as ``"temporal_snr+gaussian_blur"``, the FWHM or sigma (mm), and the mask hash. |
